run.test_evaluation: one stored prediction pass per final locked run

selection.objective: macro mean validation RMSE; validation weighted RMSE then candidate id tie-break
selection.seed_policy: first preregistered seed only; no seed selection

final.checkpoint_selection: validation RMSE only, including an epoch-0 checkpoint
final.test_policy: one prediction pass after checkpoint lock; no seed/family selection
final.ensemble: fixed equal prediction average over all preregistered effective seeds

physics_full: observed current-rate supervision after m/s to mm/s conversion

baselines.local_slope: least-squares depth slope over each partition-local window
baselines.ridge: flattened windows; train fit; validation-only alpha choice
baselines.huber: flattened windows; train IRLS fit; validation-only alpha choice

ablations.feature_window_model_reason: isolates input/window effects without an external physics-RUL branch

metrics.aggregation: single-seed mean/std plus fixed equal-prediction ensemble; fold macro is unweighted

claim_rule.maximum_text: task-specific strict best on this single trajectory
requirements: preregistered primary trainable model beats every eligible baseline on locked-fold RMSE
preregistered primary trainable model beats every eligible baseline on rolling-fold macro RMSE
primary single-seed model beats every eligible baseline in a strict majority of seed-fold cells

benchmark.selection_note: All families/seeds are reported; none is selected using test labels.

claim_audit.automatic_result: The preregistered claim criteria are not all satisfied; no task-specific best claim is made.
claim_audit.maximum_permitted_claim: task-specific strict best on this single trajectory

external_same_domain.reason: no verified machine-readable public same-task nozzle RUL dataset

historical_non_strict.status: separate historical context only; not comparable or ranked
